Payment Options
Due to delays from the State, the 2nd half due date is revised to July 27, 2026.
The Treasurer’s Office offers various payment options for
Current and Delinquent Real Estate Taxes.
E-Check
You may choose to pay your taxes online by Electronic Check .
To Pay Online , you will identify all parcels that you wish to pay. You will create an electronic check that will draw funds from your checking account in the same way a paper check is debited. Once the transaction is completed, you will receive an email confirming receipt of your payment. The check must be drawn on a regular checking account to be processed correctly. Checks associated with credit cards, mutual funds, home equity lines of credit are not eligible for this payment choice. The fee is $1.50 for your total transaction.
Pay Online by E-Check
Credit Card/Debit Card
You may choose to pay your taxes by Credit Card/Debit Card: Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover, Debit Card, and ATM/Debit Card are accepted. Payments may be made online at any time or by calling toll free at (419) 597-5015 and following the instructions. Credit Card payments can also be made in person at the Mercer County Treasurer’s Office.
Please note there is a convenience fee of 2.45% ($2.00 minimum) charged by the service provider added to your total transaction amount.
If you need assistance paying by credit card, please call the Treasurer’s Office at (419) 586-2259 .
Note: When making a mobile home payment over the phone, please substitute an asterisk “*” for the “M” in the parcel number.
Pay Online by Credit or Debit Card
Check
You may choose to pay your taxes by Check.
Please make check payable to: David E. Wolters, Mercer County Treasurer
Send to:
Mercer County Treasurer
101 North Main Street, Room 201
Celina, Ohio 45822
Cash
The Mercer County Treasurer’s Office accepts cash for Current and Delinquent Real Estate Tax payments.
ACH (Auto Pay)
This option allows you to have monthly, semi-annual, or annual tax payments automatically withdrawn from your bank account (ACH).
Annual
Your full year’s taxes will be withdrawn from your bank on the February due date. You will receive a receipt to reconcile with your bank statement.
Semi Annual
Your 1/2 year’s taxes will be withdrawn from your bank on the respective due date in February and July. You will receive a receipt to reconcile with your bank statement.
Monthly Prepay
To enroll, your property taxes must be current.
Enrollment dates are from July 20th to August 10th
On the 20th of each month, we will notify your bank to debit, (ACH), 1/12 of your present annual tax bill.
Payment cycle is from August 20th thru July 20th
Call the Treasurer’s office at (419) 586-2259 to enroll.
Benefits of ACH Payment Options
There is no charge for this service.
The funds will automatically be withdrawn from your bank or savings account when due.
You will no longer have to write a check.
Your taxes will always be paid on time.
Your taxes will be paid even when you are on vacation or sick.
You will be receiving your tax bill letting you know how much will be withdrawn from your account.
If you change banks or account numbers it is your responsibility to notify the Treasurer’s Office.
Any time there are insufficient funds in the account the taxes will be marked as unpaid.
Any time you wish to withdraw from the plan a written notice must be received by the Treasurer’s Office.
Pre-Pay (Coupon)
You can pay your taxes by scheduling smaller monthly payment through our Coupon prepay program. To enroll, your property taxes must be current.
This option provides you with monthly coupons to mail with your payment to the Treasurer’s office.
Enrollment dates are from July 20th to August 10th.
In August, you will receive 11 tax payment coupons (August thru June) to pay your estimated annual tax bill.
In order to process your payments accurately, there is a recommended payment due date effective 20th of each month.
You receive a 1st half and 2nd half tax bill.
Call the Treasurer’s office at (419) 586-2259 to enroll.
Delinquent Monthly Payment Plan
A monthly payment plan may be an option for taxpayers who have become past due with their property taxes. Property owners entering into delinquent Contracts can become current on their property taxes by, (1) making a monthly payment for their prior delinquent taxes and, (2) keeping all future real tax bills paid in full by the due date.
Penalties and interest will be deferred on the past due account as long as terms of the Contract are followed. If payments are missed, the Contract is subject to being voided and the penalty and interest that would have been added prior to the Contract will be reinstated.
Any property that is more than one (1) year past due and not participating in a delinquent monthly payment plan Contract can be subject to foreclosure or a tax lien sale. All payment plan Contracts are subject to review by the Treasurer for eligibility. To inquire about an agreement, please call the Treasurer’s office at (419) 586-2259 .
Additional payments can be made on the contracts at any time, or a contract can be paid off early without penalty. For additional information, please contact the Treasurer’s Office at (419) 586-2259 .
